features: The soundbar offers immersive audio that delivers excellent clarity and crispness. Its two 8W RMS speaker drivers provide a wide frequency range, making it perfect for enjoying your music, movies, and more.

The 2x bass reflex ports on the soundbar produce a rich, full bass that enhances the overall sound quality. Whether you're listening to music or watching a movie, the added bass depth and clarity make for a cinematic experience.

With Bluetooth 5.3 technology, you can wirelessly stream music from Bluetooth-enabled TVs, laptops, PCs, smartphones, and tablets. You can also utilize the AUX IN jack to connect to a wired audio connection.

The soundbar allows you to play back MP3 files directly from the device, and it's compatible with USB drives. This means you can easily access and play your favourite music, and more, without the need for a separate device. Plus, the simple, intuitive controls make it easy to navigate and control your entertainment.
Pairable, Portable, and Wireless: The soundbar offers up to 8 hrs of wireless playback at 50% volume owing to its 2000mAh Li-ion rechargeable battery. Charging Time: 4hrs 15mins
